entries.name: portrait_filters.metallib
entries.role: Core Image filter kernels (colour, blur, composite, generators, distortion)
entries.note: BifrOSt implements the Core Image filter categories as CPU pixel code with the reference parameters; no GPU filter kernels and no CIKernel language, so large images are slower. role inferred from the owning framework path; the metallib was not disassembled

entries.name: RawCamera.metallib
entries.role: Computer-vision, computational photography or ML image processing shaders
entries.note: A CPU Bayer demosaic with white balance and a RAW parameter model exist; the Apple RAW processor's full pipeline and its shader are not reproduced.

entries.name: raytracing_runtime_emulation.metallib
entries.role: GPU driver support shaders for Apple silicon / Apple GL-over-Metal
entries.note: Apple GPU driver internals (AGX family, GL shim); BifrOSt gets GPU drivers from Mesa/Vulkan (springboard/gpu) so there is no equivalent and no app depends on it

entries.name: Photogrammetry_GaussianSplatting_Kernels.metallib
entries.role: 3D scene / RealityKit / USD rendering and geometry processing shaders
entries.note: BifrOSt has no photogrammetry capture service; these kernels turn photo sets into splats and meshes, and no such component exists.

entries.name: Photogrammetry_MVS_Kernels.metallib
entries.role: 3D scene / RealityKit / USD rendering and geometry processing shaders
entries.note: Photogrammetry reconstruction is a service that BifrOSt does not ship.

entries.name: Photogrammetry_Matching_Kernels.metallib
entries.role: 3D scene / RealityKit / USD rendering and geometry processing shaders
entries.note: BifrOSt has 3D models (springboard/ui/src/scene3d.rs, scene_material.rs, mesh.rs, particle_system3d.rs) that draw nothing, and no 3D rasteriser or PBR shader; needed for 3D previews (Quick Look USD) and any 3D app. role inferred from the owning framework path; the metallib was not disassembled

entries.name: ProcessAccelerate.metallib
entries.role: Computer-vision, computational photography or ML image processing shaders
entries.note: BifrOSt has no on-device vision/ML image pipeline (only CPU guided filter, histogram and subject-lift models); needed for Photos edits, portrait/depth effects and image analysis. role inferred from the owning framework path; the metallib was not disassembled
